name: Office Deliveries
author: NoahTH
description: There is no race in this game, just good honest work. I've tried to credit the free assets I used in the made with section, but the Karting Microgame devours all. Here are links to all of the free assets used: https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/audio/sound-fx/96-general-library-free-sample-pack-185157, https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/audio/sound-fx/free-casual-game-sfx-pack-54116, and https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/environments/snaps-prototype-office-137490. I also used a song from Incompetech, credited in the main menu. Don't forget to enable audio and thanks for playing!
